snippet.title: Clickonomy - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3284800

Clickonomy is a cozy physics-based game where you harvest resources from your very own tiny planet just by clicking. Gather, sell, and expand your collection as you explore a charming world that’s uniquely yours — all at your own pace.

Follow the development:
X (Twitter): https://x.com/PlayClickonomy
Discord: https://discord.gg/DWHHjFJtCK

Developed by Axel Octeau.
